articleTitle: Blood Pressure Detection Using CNN-LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Blood pressure (BP) is a key indication that needs to be checked on a regular basis. For maintaining a healthy life normal blood pressure is essential, and a continuous change can cause serious problems related to health such as hypertension, deadly cardio-vascular disorders and kidney failure. Hypertension is one of the leading causes of death in the globe. For the early diagnosis and prevention of fatal occurrences, an effective unobstructed technique is required for BP monitoring on continuous basis. Here, we present a new categorization approach for BP based on PPG signal and CNN-LSTM model. Classification is performed on different levels between Normotension (NT) and Prehypertension (PHT) and between Normotension (NT) and Hypertension (HT). The findings reveal that the classification of normotension vs hypertension yields more accuracy 67.76%, which is slightly higher than normotension vs prehypertension.

articleTitle: Liver Disease Prediction using Machine learning Classification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Machine Learning is a process which is used to discover patterns in huge data/ large data set to enable decision, thereby allowing machines to go through a learning process (i.e. supervised, unsupervised and semi-supervised or reinforced). The data set used in this paper is Liver Patient taken from UCI Repository (i.e. Supervised Learning). There is a plenty of data on patients undergoing medical examination at hospitals and these data has been extracted on liver patients whose information can be further used for future improvement of their conditions. In other words, historical and classified input of patients and output data is fed into various algorithms or classifiers for predicting the future data of patients. The algorithms used here for predicting liver patients are Logistic regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, KNNeighbor, Gradient Boosting, Extreme Gradient Boosting, LightGB. Based on the analysis and result calculations, it was found that these algorithm has obtained good accuracy after feature selection.

articleTitle: A Convolutional Neural Network Approach for Diabetic Retinopathy Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a kind of problem which affects diabetic patients, particularly those at their age of working, and can result in vision impairment and possibly irreversible blindness. For diagnosis and to prevent blindness or degeneration, early detection is critical. When ophthalmologists execute the diagnosis step of DR manually, it takes more time, effort, and money, and there are more possibility of misdiagnosis. The scientific community is focusing on developing a computer-aided recognition system for early identification and grading of DR severity. Ongoing AI research has highlighted the growth of the deep learning technique, which is better technique for doing medical image analysis and classification.

articleTitle: Proposal on NFT Minter for Blockchain-based Art-Work Trading System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: NFT is an abbreviation for non-fungible token, which indicates it cannot be replaced or interchanged due to its unique features. It is just a digital asset which symbolizes online collectibles such as art, music, and games and is protected by an authentic certificate generated by the block-chain technology that underpins cryptocurrency. The most important use of NFTs nowadays is in digital material. NFTs boost content producers' revenues by powering a creator economy in which artists cede ownership of their work to the networks they use to advertise it. Keeping in mind we have developed a system where one can mint the desired artwork directly from the web app which is automatically added to his OpenSea marketplace with his metamask wallet address which he will be use to create the account on OpenSea. The artwork will spontaneously be visible in my collection section of OpenSea from where the person can do many things including the change in the price of Artwork (NFT) he owns and release it on sale or take it out for auction. Also, details like elements of the artwork and contract address are also available which provides access to view all the activities performed by that particular NFT.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Convolutional Recurrent (CNN-GRU) Model for Stock Price Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Stock price forecasting systems are on-demand that used for prediction in the financial world. The deep learning models are used for handling large data and making predictions more accurately than the traditional methods. This paper proposed a hybrid convolutional recurrent model architecture for stock price prediction based on exploitation of two different deep learning models properties into a single model. Hybrid Convolutional Recurrent Model consists of 1D-CNN and GRU where 1D-CNN is leveraged as feature extraction task and GRU for temporal regression. The proposed CNN-GRU Model outperform for stock price prediction. The performance evaluation and comparison analysis between the existing hybrid models and proposed hybrid model have also been done with experiments to justify.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning for Sentiment Analysis of Movies Using IMDB Rating
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In today’s environment, the customer behavior related to the product is important. The rapid growth of social media has made it easier to collect information about our products. Billions of customers share information about their products on social media pages. Manually managing large amounts of social media information is difficult. However, we have proposed a framework for analyzing customer sentiment using data mining and machine learning algorithms. The proposed framework consists of several steps to processes the information and try to find the good accuracy of the classification. The proposed framework is used for sentiment analysis of movie using IMDB rating. In this paper, the data preprocessing and feature extraction are done using data mining techniques. The result analysis shows that the proposed framework can be useful for better decision-making.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Rice Seedling using Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The objective of deep learning is used to recognise crops and weeds on the farm. It can be also termed as smart farming. To reduce the pollution caused by spraying excess fertilizer and herbicide in the rice crops, it becomes necessary to correctly locate the rice seedling and weed. Rice seedling Segmentation remains a difficult process. In this paper, we propose a method called semantic segmentation using FCN, Unet, Fast-SCNN, SegNet to differentiate weed from crops. The average accuracy of SegNet is 92.08% and using Unet is 87.5% which is an evolved model of CNN. We have illustrated different algorithms for this process but the main architecture is SegNet which has shown best accuracy among them.

articleTitle: CNN Architecture for Lung Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Lungs play major role for the respiratory rate in a human being. Lung cancer can be detected only after the disease spreads to neighboring parts and hence detecting lung cancer in initial stage is difficult. Even in covid-19, lung gets affected as it deals with respiration which is the first symptom in serious covid conditions. In this paper, we have proposed a method to detect the lung cancer which involves feature extraction and ML algorithm or in another way using CNN architecture which is a DL algorithm helps in lung cancer detection. As the methods deal with binary classification which confirms yes/no of the lung cancer presence in human body, both SVM and CNN methods are simpler than any other ML/DL algorithms for this lung cancer data considered. Simulations are carried out in google colab. Feature extraction is carried out for ML algorithm and bar graph, histograms are plotted.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based Spectrum Sensing for Secured Cognitive Radio wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: A blockchain based security improvement as well as spectrum sensing technique is proposed in this article for regulating the spectrum and identifying fraudulent users in the cognitive radio (CR) wireless networks. Spectrum sensing is a key need in the CR wireless networks, and it gets infected by the fraudulent user. The fraudulent user is disrupting the reliability of the system performance by targeting the network’s overall signal detection. The presence of a fraudulent user in CR wireless networks causes incorrect detecting data to be transmitted, lowering the system’s performance. The CR wireless network achieves blockchain based security and spectrum sensing, enhancing system performance. An energy detection technique is used to identify the fraudulent user in the CR wireless networks using the blockchain oriented approach. Performance measures such as probability of detection, and number of chosen sensing nodes are used to assess the suggested approach. Existing techniques like Tidal Trust and Friend or Foe Algorithm are compared with the suggested method.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of SWIPT Enabled Decode-and-Forward based Cooperative Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this paper, we explore performance of a simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) enabled cooperative decode-and-forward two-way relay network over Nakagami-m fading channels for 5G and beyond wireless communication systems. The considered cooperative network consists a relay and two source nodes with a direct link. For simultaneous information processing and energy harvesting, a power splitting (PS) protocol based SWIPT receiver is considered at the relay node. The energy constraint relay node harvests energy from the received radio-frequency signal and utilizes the harvested energy for information broadcasting. A selection combining technique is adopted at the destination node to combine both the received signals via relay and direct links. For performance analysis, the closed-form expression of the outage probability and throughput are derived over Nakagami-m fading channels. The impact of fading severity, PS factor, threshold data rate, and other system parameters are highlighted on the system performance. Accuracy of the obtained closed-form expressions are justified through Monte-Carlo simulations.

articleTitle: Fifth Generation MIMO Antenna Array With Diversity and Mutual Coupling Reduction Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this paper, a compact multiple input multiple output (MIMO) antenna array is designed with the defected ground structure (DGS) using spatial diversity techniques on Rogers RT/duroid 5880 substrate having the dimension of 11 x 30 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with the thickness of 0.79 mm. The MIMO antenna array with DGS has improved the gain and isolation of the antenna. The gain of the proposed MIMO antenna array is 9.84 dBi with 96.59% radiating efficiency at 28 GHz resonant frequency. The -10 dB impedance bandwidth lies from 26.38-29.68 GHz. In this paper, the MIMO performance metrics are calculated such as isolation, envelope correlation coefficient, diversity gain, and channel capacity loss. The ECC and diversity gain values are 1.29 x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-7</sup> and 9.99 dB, respectively, at 28 GHz. The channel capacity loss for MIMO antenna is below 0.4 bps/Hz in the operating band and the isolation (|S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf>| = 41.25 dB) at 28 GHz and |S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf>| > 28 dB in the complete operating band. All the calculated parameters are satisfied as per the standard of the ITU. The proposed MIMO antenna is a good candidate for a 5G wireless communication system.

articleTitle: Classification of Cervical Precancerous Cell of ThinPrep Images Based on Deep Learning Model AlexNet and InceptionV3
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Cervical cancer is one of the deadliest diseases in the world, responsible for the greatest number of fatalities. Around 569.847 new cervical cancer cases are recorded every year. Efforts to prevent this condition can be conducted by early identification. There are several methods to detect cervical cancer, one of which is ThinPrep. In identifying cervical cancer, a neural network can be utilized as an alternative. AlexNet and InceptionV3 are neural network frequently applied to detect various diseases. In this study cervical cell images were classified based on cell severity, using deep learning models AlexNet and InceptionV3. The results it can be known that Inception V3 has a better performance based on the performance matrix analysis of the both models. The best performance matrix results for InceptionV3 are 89.80% for accuracy, 89.81% for precision, 91.17% for sensitivity, 94.49% for specificity, and 89.26% for F-score. However, AlexNet’s training time have much faster than InceptionV3, with an average training time 57 seconds and fastest training time 55 seconds.

articleTitle: Cancer Prediction Using Random Forest and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Cancer is a medical condition in which cells divide abnormally in the human body and spread to other body parts. If the prognosis of cancer is done well in advance, it is curable. It is estimated that 22.2 million individuals would be impacted by cancer between now and 2030. There are about 100 different forms of cancer, which are categorized based on criteria including age, gender, and race/ethnicity. Cancer in organs such as the lung, liver, kidney, breast, and brain was investigated in the present study. The data for the Lung Cancer study came from the Kaggle online system, the TCIA informed on kidney cancer (The Cancer Imaging Archive), the HCC Liver Cancer dataset, the Brain Cancer dataset from data. World, and the Wisconsin dataset for breast cancer. The proposed approaches to classify cancer's malignancy were Random Forest Classifier, Convolutional Neural Network, and ResNet50. Lung, Liver, Kidney, Breast, and Brain cancers had accuracy rates of 99 percent, 75.75 percent, 88.09 percent, 96 percent, and 81 percent, respectively.

articleTitle: Rice Leaf Disease Detection using Mobile Net and Inception V.3
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: An increase in the demand of rice production tons of rice is consumed each year but due to many bacteria in the rice leaf plant result in the shortage of production in rice this can affect a loss of rice. Each year almost everyone is facing this issue so to resolve the issue we need to find a quick solution that identifies the bacteria as early as possible and treat the root cause of diseases with the correct pesticide, due to this the development of image processing is going to help in this solution. so, we are going to use a technique in which we have mobile net and inception net we had evaluated the consistency and each criterion of a system by using mobile net we achieved training accuracy of 98.92% and validation accuracy of 70.31% also from inspection net we achieved an accuracy of 96.88% and validation accuracy of 76.56%.

articleTitle: An Integrated Methodology of Ranking Based on PROMETHEE-CRITIC and TOPSIS-CRITIC In Web Service Domain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the increase in technology and resources, number of web services are available that can meet the similar needs of web clients. Out of the numerous available web services, it is becoming difficult for the web user to choose the correct and relevant web service from among the similar web services. In this paper we have taken the quality of service (QoS) criteria in the determination of most relevant web service(s). All the more exactly, we propose two part combine effort using objective weight calculation method for weight evaluation of each criteria followed by ranking of the web services using well established MCDM methods. For QoS criteria weight calculation "Criteria Importance Through Intercriteria Correlation" (CRITIC) method is used and ranking of web services is obtained by using PROMETHEE-II and "Technique for ordered preference by similarity to the ideal solution" (TOPSIS) methods. In order to show the stability of the proposed method, a prototype of a web services ranking is implemented. The data set of real world "Quality of Web Service" (QWS) is used for the experimentation. On observing the result, it is found that both ranking method perform well also the rank reversal problem of TOPSIS method is get solved by using the CRITIC QoS weights.

articleTitle: Design of dual-band MIMO antenna with inverted L-shaped arms for 5G applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: A dual-band MIMO antenna design for 5G application is proposed which consists of 2-symmetrical monopole antenna elements. The resonant frequency of monopole antenna is tunable. Grounded branches and defected ground structure (DGS) are used in design to reduce mutual coupling of lower band by modifying the current distribution on ground plane. The proposed design with 2:1 VSWR on Rogers RO4003C substrate has dimension of 92×38.6×1.524 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The design covers 2.35- 2.57 GHz and 4.9-5.1 GHz frequency bands and isolation in bands is more than 10 dB. The gain of MIMO antenna at 2.46 GHz and 5.0 GHz frequencies are 4.24 dBi and 6.35 dBi respectively.

articleTitle: Image Forgery Localization using Image Patches and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Due to the broad accessibility of camera systems, photographing has grown in popularity. Photos seem to be significant in our daily lives since they carry a plethora of data, and it is frequently necessary to improve photographs to acquire greater information. Although many technologies are available to enhance the images, these are also often utilized to fabricate photos, leading to the spreading of disinformation. Image forgeries are becoming a serious topic of concern. To locate image forgeries, several conventional frameworks have been developed in the past. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have garnered much popularity in recent years, and CNN’s have influenced image forgery localization. One of the most difficult images forgery types is image splicing, in which a part of an image is copied into another image. Image forgery localization techniques that exist in the literature have some limitations. Hence, it is essential to develop a technique for effectively and accurately locating forgeries in the tampered images. We present a strong deep learning-based approach for detecting forgery in an image by using image patches. A patch is taken around it to classify a pixel in an image, which is passed to a CNN to predict whether the pixel belongs to the tampered region. The proposed method efficiently predicts the boundary pixels of the tampered region and the background image. The technique has been rigorously evaluated, and the experiment results obtained are extremely encouraging on CASIA 2.0 database.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Models For Early Detection of Fetal Disease using Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In today’s world, fetal diseases has become a common problem faced by the majority of pregnant woman around the globe. The fetal disease is a serious ingrown malformation in children. These diseases can be diagnosed through heart functioning which is identified using Fetal Electrocardiogram signals. Early detection of such fatal diseases can save many lives. To this end, echocardiogram signals remain the most effective method and our experimental research is quite relevant. This research work is an involved comparative study of different classifier models for the early diagnosis of fetal disease. The experiment consists of 10 classifier models including sequential models with hyper-parameter tunning. Each classifier model is evaluated based on its accuracy, recall, precision, and other evaluation parameters. The experimental results show that XGBoost and LightGBM Classifier models show accuracy as high as 95.14% followed by the Gradient Boost classifier model with an accuracy of 94.67%. However, the maximum recall value was achieved by the XGBoost classifier.

articleTitle: Sub-Terahertz MIMO Array Antenna for Future Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In the era of wireless communication, requirement of wireless devices are increasing rapidly. To fulfil the demand of services like as video conferencing, real time data transmission, internet of things (IOT), high bandwidth and high data rate are required so for the future wireless communication sub-terahertz frequency band is going to play an important role because it provides large bandwidth and high data rate upto 10 Gbps so for the future wireless applications 2×4 MIMO array antenna design is proposed, this design resonates at 0.281 and 0.282 THz as well as for the transmission capability CCL and TARC is also discussed.

articleTitle: Ultra Wideband MIMO Antenna Design with High Isolation for THz Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this paper, antenna designed is proposed for Ultra wideband 2×2 MIMO antenna design with high isolation for THz application, it is designed using rectangular shape radiator with a cut of circular shape and occupies the size of 133×255 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>which provide -10 dB impedance in 5.5 to greater than 10 THz frequency band as well as it is discussed the method to achieve better isolation, this design shows isolation parameter -66.27 dB (S12) and -69.6 dB (S21) at 8.19 THz. For the suitability of antenna for communication system CCL and TRAC is also calculated which are in acceptable limit.

articleTitle: Iterative Hard Thresholding Using Least Squares Initialization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: An improvement of the typical iterative hard thresholding (IHT) algorithm is presented by means of least squares initialization. Unlike the initialization that assigns all zeros to the initial estimate, the linearized least squares estimate is instead adopted herein. Numerical examples are conducted under a sparse signal recovery problem. Performance of the proposed approach in terms of root-mean-square relative error (RMSRE), computational time, and memory consumption is compared to the typical IHT algorithm. It is shown in numerical example that a good initialization can deliver lower RMSRE, less computational time, and less memory requirement.

articleTitle: Stepped Patch Antenna for GSM Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The stepped shaped patch antenna is designed for GSM applications. The proposed antenna resonates at 900 MHz with -10 dB impedance band of 874-958 MHz. The gain of proposed antenna varies from 1.6-1.9 dBi in presented band. The radiation and total efficiencies of the stepped patch antenna is more than 65% is observed in proposed band. The size of the antenna is 72.9 x 96.9 x 1..524 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The radiation impact on biological tissues is analyzed by parameter specific absorption rate (SAR) and found the value < 1.0 W/kg near the human head and ear.

articleTitle: A Combined Voltage and Frequency Stability Enhancement using Artificial Neural Network and Fast Voltage Stability Index Based Load Shedding
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The load shedding plan for voltage and Frequency stability is an important means for operators to maintain a stable and reliable state of the power system when it suffers from severe disturbance. In a power system the load shedding based on critical undervoltage or underfrequency provides protection when the system frequency or voltage drop below a prespecified value. This paper presents a load shedding scheme that stabilizes the system during both undervoltage and underfrequency scenarios. The scheme is developed in MATLAB where artificial neural network is used with reference to under frequency whereas Fast voltage stability index is used for voltage stability analysis. The effectiveness of the scheme is verified in an IEEE 6 bus system which is developed in power world simulator.

articleTitle: Zonal Irregularity Drift Characteristics of Ionospheric Scintillations from two closely-spaced Global Navigation Satellite System receivers at an Indian Low Latitude location
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The zonal drift velocity of small-scale ionospheric irregularities associated with the equatorial plasma bubbles (EPBs) of a low latitude station K L University campus (16°26’ N, 80°37’ E, 7.78° N dip latitude), Guntur, India is calculated using the spaced receiver method. The cross-correlation technique is used to calculate the drift velocity of the ionospheric irregularities from the carrier to noise ratio (C/N0) observations recorded at global positioning system (GPS) L1 frequency at two different ionospheric monitoring receivers spaced at a distance of 210m which is within the first Fresnel radius. The details of the cross-correlation technique with an example are illustrated. The results show an apparent eastward velocity with a maximum value above 220 m/s at 18:00 UT that decreased gradually towards midnight. The maximum S4 index on the geomagnetically disturbed day in October 2021 reached up to a level of 1. The analysis in this study is towards an improved understanding of drifting characteristics of ionospheric irregularities above the location. This may help in developing a suitable ionospheric scintillation mitigation algorithm for high-performance positioning and navigation accuracy in global navigation satellite system (GNSS) receivers.

articleTitle: Design of Bandstop Filter using Double Dumbbell Shaped CSRR in Ground
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: A double complementary split-ring resonators (CSRR) dumbbell-shaped defected ground structure (DB-DGS) bandstop filter is designed and proposed on FR-4 dielectric substrate with compact size 30.91×34.78 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and low return loss in passband at 2.28 GHz frequency. The proposed CSRR DB-DGS bandstop filter is designed with insertion loss of −28.06 dB in stopband and −0.66 dB return loss. Also, it is compared with the single CSRR DB-DGS which has sharp roll-off factor. The proposed design is the modified version of the designs used with single CSRR. The proposed design is compared with the existing designs for the better outcomes of the BSF CSRR DB-DGS.

articleTitle: Analysis of Power in SRAM Cell with Various Pull up, Pull down and Pass Gate Transistors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: SRAM cell plays major role in many microelectronic and nano electronic devices. Low power consumption or low leakage power, high speed operations to match the recent trends are the challenges in SRAM designs. In this work, we have designed a 6T SRAM which has 6 transistors with 2 pull up, 2 pull down and 2 transistors acting as pass gate transistors, cross coupling between the pull up and pull down vertical connections helps in maintaining the sleep mode leakage power in SRAM cell. Threshold conditions can be introduced for high speed operations in SRAM. 6T SRAM is designed in cadence with 90nm technology, further the layout is drawn for 90nm technology and the output waveforms from SRAM cell layout are presented.

articleTitle: Secure and Traceable QR Code Using Blockchain-enabled Certificates
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The blockchain has been considered to be a breakthrough technology solution for problems based on security aspects. It is a Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) which can be used to established trust among different trustless entities or nodes present in the network. Furthermore, Quick Response (QR) Codes are likewise one of the most promising innovations going on in the markets. In QR code, small dots are present which get converted to binary numbers and get validated with error correcting algorithms. Hence, QR codes are beneficial for both storage and authentication. In this article, we discuss the prospects of combination of these two technologies for better results. In this paper, we aim to develop permission-less Blockchain, which is relatively easier to compute and have shown to increase its data capacity. It also endeavored to add the QR Code incorporation to a block and make it more scalable with considering the limited space in a such block.

articleTitle: Application of DRL in Transformer Network for Traffic Signal Management using Fog Computing in ITS
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: As globalisation has immensely intensified, the enormous expansion of vehicles in metropolitan areas has significantly overloaded the existing transportation networks. An appropriate traffic signal control strategy has the potential to have a favourable impact on urban transportation, both economically and environmentally. The main target of this study is to evaluate the optimal traffic signal pattern using a fog computing based Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) method. The effective implementation of this method in the Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) enhances traffic movement while decreasing congestion difficulties. The DRL agent is trained by employing the Policy gradient approach in the state-of-the-art transformer network to strengthen the decision-making mechanism, which notably contributes to determine the optimal traffic signal selection policy. Extensive simulation experiments have been conducted with both synthetic and real-time road maps to corroborate the outcomes and the proposed approach shows considerable improvements when compared to the baseline.

articleTitle: Principal Component Analysis of VHO parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this research article, we have designed an algorithm for Vertical Handover (VHO) based on Principal Component Analysis (PCA).Vertical Handover is extremely important in designing & dimensioning the network. In practical scenarios, it is very difficult to monitor the various parameters of Vertical Handover (VHO) as it puts a lot of load in the system. Thus in order to reduce the load we have designed an algorithm for network selection using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) which reduces multi-dimensional data into one dimensional data. The main parameters taken into consideration are Received Signal Strength (RSS), Bandwidth, Cost and Velocity of the user.

articleTitle: Enhancement in the Network Capacity using MIMO and Antenna Array in 5G Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The main motive of wireless communication system is to provide better facility and fairness among the users. The main objective is to serve as many users as possible with best data rates and flexibility. All this should happen under the restrictions of radiation spread limit and limited cost. So, when it comes to increase the data rate then the main thing to consider is SNR that is Signal to noise ratio. The resources are limited so the focus should be on the reuse of the resources in order to increase the number of users and hence capacity. This paper is going to cover step by step compression sof SISO, SIMO, MISO and MIMO. The graph is plotted between BER and SNR in most cases. At the end while using MIMO it can be seen that capacity has been improved. In the created scenario we’ll see how SNR and capacity can be improved by using antenna arrays over the wireless channel

articleTitle: Medical Data Retrieval By Named Data Networking of Things Architecture in Contiki NG OS
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) is becoming an important approach to accomplish healthcare monitoring where critical medical data retrieval is essential in a secure and private manner. Nevertheless, IoT devices have constrained resources. Therefore, acquisition of efficient, secure and private data is very challenging. The current research on applying architecture of Named Data Networking (NDN) to IoT design reveals very promising results. Therefore, we are motivated to combine NDN and IoT, which we call NDN-IoT architecture, for a healthcare application. Inspired by the idea, we propose a healthcare monitoring groundwork integrating NDN concepts into IoT in Contiki NG OS at the network layer that we call μNDN as it is a micro and light-weight implementation. We quantitatively explore the usage of the NDN-IoT approach to understand its efficiency for medical data retrieval. Reliability and delay performances were evaluated and analyzed for a remote health application. Our results, in this study, show that the μNDN architecture performs better than IP architecture when retrieving medical data. Thus, it is worth exploring the μNDN architecture further.

articleTitle: Face Mask Detection Analysis for Covid19 Using CNN and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The planet was severely affected by Coronavirus Disease 2019. The wearing of masks in public places is a big way of protecting people. In addition, many providers of public service only require consumers to wear masks correctly. However, only a few studies are focused on image analysis on face mask detection. I propose in this paper, a high-precision and effective mask detector for Mask Detection Method. Recognition from faces is a popular and significant technology in recent years. Face alterations and the presence of different masks make it too much challenging. In the real-world, when a person is uncooperative with the systems such as in video surveillance then masking is further common scenarios. For these masks, current face recognition performance degrades. An abundant number of researches work has been performed for recognizing faces under different conditions like changing pose or illumination, degraded images, etc. Still, difficulties created by masks are usually disregarded. The primary concern to this work is about facial masks, and especially to enhance the recognition accuracy of different masked faces. A feasible approach has been proposed that consists of first detecting the facial regions. So, n orders to detect whether you are wearing a face mask to protect yourself, I decided to construct a simple and basic Convolutional Neural Network model, using TensorFlow and Keras library. With the prevailing pandemic of COVID-19, these systems will benefit many kinds of organizations worldwide. These types of systems are especially important.

articleTitle: A Key Escrow Free Anonymous Identity Based Encryption Scheme using Ring Signatures
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Identity-based encryption (IBE) is an encryption scheme that is proposed to eliminate the need for certificates to certify the public keys of receivers in public-key cryptography (PKC). Nevertheless, the key escrow problem is a major problem to deploy identity-based encryption (IBE) in real-time. If the private key generator (PKG) is malicious, then he can decrypt all the messages. In this paper, we proposed an anonymous identity-based encryption scheme using ring signatures to solve this problem. In this process, the identity will get the corresponding private key from the key generation authority (KGA) by signing on masked identity using the ring signature generated by ring authority (RA). The KGA has no way of knowing who received which key. Hence, it solves the key escrow problem. While most existing techniques require certificates to ensure anonymity, which is also a motive for IBE, the proposed scheme will obtain the relevant key anonymously based on the ring signatures. In this paper, a proof of security of the proposed scheme is also presented along with the scheme.

articleTitle: Prioritization for time slot allocation and message transmission in TDMA MAC for VANETs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In VANETs, vehicles communicate with infrastructure, RSU and other vehicles for improved safety measures. Safety, non-safety and control messages are exchanged during the communication. Timely delivery of highly important and urgent messages (HIUM) is required for reliable communication. Hence, prioritization is required for guaranteed and timely delivery of the messages. The allocation of time slots for maximizing the delivery of HIUM is the main focus of the proposed approach. In this paper, we have proposed a two-step prioritization algorithm where the vehicles are prioritized based on the priority of the messages at OBU. Based on the message prioritization and vehicle type, the time slots are allocated to the vehicles at RSU. The proposed approach guarantees the timely delivery of the HIUM for reliable communication.

articleTitle: Monitoring Social Distancing based on Regression Object detector for reducing Covid-19
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: To deal with the worldwide coronavirus epidemic situation, the procedure of pulling down the Covid-19 cases will be tough to handle, if people do not take steps to thwart the virus from spreading. One of the most significant strategies in this pandemic is to keep a safe distance among the persons in public areas. This paper aims to detect persons with social distance monitoring as a preventive technique in minimizing physical connection between persons. The workflow of this paper is to detect the people in the area of interest using the YOLOv5 model. The model is trained on the Open Images V6 dataset and takes categories of people and human faces. Further, a social distancing algorithm is applied to check the distance between two persons and mark the red boundary box if any person violates the rules. The network provides inference speed capable of offering real-time results with maximum accuracy. The accuracy is achieved 99% in real-time scenarios using the proposed work. In various contexts, the suggested social distancing strategy produces promising outcomes.

articleTitle: Location Based Routing in Multi-hop Clustering Based Network Structure of VANET
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Vehicular ad-hoc network is emerging as an efficient solution against many significant issues like minimizing accidents, managing traffic and providing comfort services on the road. However, the fast topological changes due to high-speed vehicles are the biggest challenge in reliable and time-bound communication. Clustering improves the stability of the network by minimizing the effect of fast topological changes. The multi-hop clustering category is proven better than single-hop clustering in terms of high cluster coverage and the number of clusters formed. An efficient routing strategy in the network manages effective communication among end-to-end vehicles. We have suggested location-based routing in the existing advanced multi-hop clustering-based network structure. To check the communication performance of our work, we have considered the application where vehicles require services like parking/oil filling station information at a particular location in advance during the journey. The routing performance is evaluated on various important parameters like packet delivery ratio (PDR), routing overhead etc., on different communication ranges of vehicles. This is the first paper presenting routing analysis over a multi-hop cluster-based network structure based on neighborhood following strategy. So our work provides depth analysis and creates the scope for researchers to carry the work at a further stage.

articleTitle: Sub-THz High Efficiency MIMO Antenna for Short Range Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: As demand for high speed and high bandwidth wireless communication is increasing day by day. Sub-THz antennas play a major role to fulfill demand of high speed communication. In this paper 2 × 2 MIMO antenna is designed on RT5880 substrate providing 95 % efficiency over all the frequency band and gain of 7.4 dBi and 8.69 dBi at resonating frequencies respectively. The designed antenna is compact with size 1430×1400×100 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. An elliptical shaped patch is used to improve gain as it radiates equally in all directions and increases directivity. The feed of the antenna is given as inset feed to improve bandwidth and return loss.

articleTitle: Capacity Enhancement for Cellular System using 5G Technology, mmWave and Higher order Sectorization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: When we talk about the network capacity then the current 4G LTE network cannot support more than a thousand users per base station. The upcoming 5G technology will able to handle the techniques such as higher order sectorization, link adaptation and MIMO systems with mmWave. In this paper a thorough study have been done and the simulation shows how the capacity can be improved with these techniques in case of 5G. Using the number of sectors per cell with S=3, 6 and 12 all the simulation have been done and in the end of this paper it has been introduced that how the use of these increased number of sectors with mmWave can enhance the capacity.

articleTitle: A Compact MIMO Antenna with High Isolation and Gain-Bandwidth Product for Wireless Personal Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) system consisting of multiple antenna elements faces issue of isolation performance between antenna elements. In this paper, isolation is improved by inserting a thin parasitic slit between antennas on the upper side and a plus-shaped stub in the ground plane. The proposed MIMO antenna consists of two bevelled circular antennas with a common partial ground. It is designed on FR-4 substrate having 12.5 mm x 24 mm x 1.6 mm dimensions. Bevelling is applied at the bottom of a circular patch to attain wideband performance. This antenna achieved bandwidth from 5.22 GHz to 14.89 GHz and offers isolation better than 15 dB in most of the operational bands while isolation more than 20 dB in the entire X-band. The Envelope Correlation Coefficient (ECC) of the antenna is less than 0.017 and DG is more than 9.9175. It offers an acceptable gain between 1.12 to 3 dBi and radiation efficiency between 57 to 75 %. The simulation and measurement results show good agreement. The designed MIMO antenna is compatible with WLAN (5.2 GHz to 5.8 GHz), upper C-band (5.22 GHz to 8 GHz), X-band (8 GHz to12 GHz) and lower Ku-band (12 GHz to 14.89 GHz) applications.

articleTitle: Cross-Layer based Energy Efficient Reliable Data Transmission System for IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Energy efficiency and data reliability are stringent requirements for today’s IoT networks. In order to achieve energy efficiency transmission power and energy level of the node during data transmission should be optimized. There is a trade-off between energy efficiency and the reliability of received data. Cross-Layer based Energy Efficient Reliable Data Transmission System (CLEERDTS) for IoT Networks is proposed in this research work such that energy consumption is minimized and reliable data delivery is achieved. In this proposed cross-layer model, the location information of nodes is embedded in the network layer, transmit power is estimated at Media Access Control (MAC) layer and thereafter transmission mode is decided at the physical layer. During route discovery, when the sender receives the Route Reply packet, it estimates the SNR value and selects the route which utilizes minimum transmit power and higher SNR. If no such route exists, it selects candidate relay nodes between the sender and Base station (BS) such that the residual energy of the relay node is highest among possible candidates. Simulation results show that the proposed CLEERDTS model offers better performance as compared to the existing model in terms of energy consumption, packet delivery ratio, packet error rate and throughput.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Machine Learning Techniques for Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Machine Learning is ever advancing field and as more and more research is being done in the field, more applications are being developed for this field and it is now being used in all fields. Also, nowadays people are facing multiples diseases posing danger to human life. This prompted researchers to critically analyse and work to apply Machine learning in the use of prediction of these diseases and using this analysis to assist the medical industry. The idea is to find various datasets of different Diseases like Dengue, Covid-19. Perform analysis on the datasets of these diseases to understand more about them and how much they affect us. There are various models available like KNN, SVM, etc. The task is to work with different models and find out how they perform with data of different diseases and which models are most affective and accurate.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm Optimized Gain Augmented Dual Band Printed Antenna for Cognitive eHealth Care (IoMT) Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: The aim of 6G wireless communication by leveraging the internet of medical things is cognitive remote monitoring in the telehealth applications (IoMT). To meet this criterion, a high bandwidth antenna with a significant quantity of gain must be constructed. Furthermore, it is advantageous if the antenna can operate in multiple frequency bands. A U-slotted rectangular shaped antenna with dimensions 4.75 cm x 4.25 cm x 0.16 cm operating in dual frequency bands of 2.45 GHz and 5 GHz is presented and developed in this research utilizing the Genetic algorithm optimization approach. The technological revolution in health monitoring sectors, enabled by wireless electronic devices, uses the least amount of hospital labor and resources. An antenna is built by using HFSS modeling, exhibiting a wide bandwidth of 940 MHz and 780 MHz and a gain of about 7 dB in the two frequency bands of operation. The antenna is optimized by using Genetic Algorithm technique.

articleTitle: An Improved Intrusion Dectection System using BoT-IoT Dataset
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Security concern in IoTs is gaining massive attention from researchers. IoT has the power to transform the world. It is grounded in homes, education, energy, mobiles and many more. Thus, it is widely accepted by the public, which makes IoT devices vulnerable to newer kinds of attacks, ultimately posing a challenge to the professionals in cyber security. Intrusion detection is a way to detect the attacks in the traffic data collected from sensors via the network. Over many years, machine learning techniques have been widely used for intrusion detection purposes. This paper proposes a compact and efficient feed-forward artificial neural network with the eXtreme Gradient Boosting algorithm and obtaining satisfactory results for intrusion detection in IoT.

articleTitle: Brain Tumour Detection using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Several health organisations have identified brain tumour as the second leading cause of human death worldwide, and early detection is critical to saving lives. Biomedical Image Processing includes a variety of imaging methods such as CT scan, X-ray and Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) that employ diverse approaches such as artificial neural networks (ANN), Fuzzy c-means (FCM), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and K-means. In this study, we devised a successful Watershed algorithm, which is used to detect brain tumours using MRI data.

articleTitle: Protection Scheme for Utility Network with Wind Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: A protection scheme method (PSM) is proposed in this manuscript to detect faulty condition on utility grid with wind power generation. This is based on decomposition of currents using Hilbert transform (HT), Stockwell transform (ST), and Alienation coefficient (ACF). A fault index (FI) is designed for detection of fault conditions. An index for ground with fault (GFI) is also designed to recognize involvement of ground during with fault condition. Faults are categorized considering faulty phase numbers and GFI. PSM effectively recognized and categorized the fault events including fault on phase-A and ground (AGF), fault on phases-A& B (ABF), fault on phases-A& B and ground (ABGF), fault on all phases (ABCF) and fault on all phases with ground (ABCGF). Performance of PSM is better compared to ACF based PSM. Study is validated on IEEE-13 nodes test system interfaced with a wind power generator in MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: The Effect of Frequency Slot Demand in Elastic Optical Network (EON)
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this paper, the effect of frequency slot demand in problem of routing and spectrum assignment has been investigated in EON. The Probability of connection acceptance is affected by the frequency slot demand of requests. Request is accepted only when requested frequency slots are available in the entire route of the request. Here, the effect of frequency slot demand is evaluated on three different network parameters: Bandwidth Blocking Probability (BBP), Network Capacity Utilized (NCU), and Cost of Connection Request (CCR). Simulation results show that at same network load BBP drastically increases as the number of frequency slot demands in requests increases. Furthermore, network capacity utilization for large number of frequency slots connections is less due to spectrum unavailability. Also, CCR for large number of frequency slots is very high.

articleTitle: Optimized Dual-mode Security Encryption Chip Design Based on Hash Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the arrival of the 5G era, IoT develops and promotes rapidly and the security issues of IoT are concerned increasingly. SHA256 and SM3 are significant hash encryption algorithms that can improve the security of IoT systems. This paper proves the equivalence between partial Boolean functions of these two encryption algorithms and designs a shared security encryption circuit that can support SM3 and SHA256 modes. Compared with the traditional design, the area of this design decreases by 17.3%. To improve the speed and reduce power consumption, this design is optimized by precomputation and reducing the signal update frequency. The precomputation part shortens the critical path and increases the maximum frequency and throughput successfully. The power optimization part also improves energy efficiency. After function verification, this design can encrypt the original message correctly and efficiently and is synthesized based on the 65nm LVt process library of SMIC.

articleTitle: Unscented Kalman Filter-Based Bayesian Filtering of RC Circuit
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this paper, we present output voltage estimation of second order resistor capacitor (RC) low pass filter (LPF) circuit using the unscented Kalman filter (UKF). Firstly, with the use of state space depiction we formulated a deterministic model of RC LPF circuit. The deterministic model is then transformed into the stochastic model by introducing noise to circuit components and input source. Finally, the MHE method and UKF method have been simulated to obtain the optimal state estimate when the circuit elements are affected by the Gaussian noise process. The derived mathematical expressions, so obtained, are simulated in MATLAB software. Then the comparison is shown between the estimated output values and PSPICE simulated values (actual output values) and digression of estimated output is expressed in the context of root mean square error (RMSE) to represent a loss function. The RMSE values validates the efficacy of proposed method with respect to the latter method.

articleTitle: A Toxic Content Detection Technique in Sentimental Analysis with Convolution Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In the recent time, the usage of various social media platforms has drastically increased which involves the positive or negative impact on human lives. One of the aspects is directly associated with comment/opinion which individual user/person passes through different social networking sites. This paper provides the discussion on different approaches to analyze classification and modelling techniques for detecting toxic comments using convolution neural networks (CNN). It also specifies algorithm based on outlier detection on given data stream that can evaluate the posted material on social platforms and check its positive and negative impact on the society.

articleTitle: Fall Accident Detection System for Bicycle Riders using Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Bicycle riders have a very high impact on accident injuries when compared to motorists. Indian road accident report-2019 shows an increase in the fatal rate of 14% accidents to bicyclists when compared to 2018. Accidents occurring in urban areas at night may contribute to a delay in reporting the accidents to emergency centers. Therefore, a fast system development is essential to detect and notify the accidents to the nearest health care centers. This article proposes a compact design of hardware to fulfill the necessity. This hardware module is responsible to measure the features related to bicycle riding and fall accidents. For measuring the features, a magnetic, angular rate, gravity (MARG) sensor-based system is used. It consists of an accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer for measuring the signals like acceleration, angular velocity, etc. Here, the popular machine learning technique called the support vector machines (SVM) algorithm is used for the detection of fall accidents. Simulation results are compared with the existing system to illustrate the improved accuracy of 95% of the fall accidents for bicycle riders.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Performance of Hash Function Using Autonomous Initial Value Proposed Secure Hash Algorithm 256
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: To verify the integrity and confidentiality of data communicated through the web is a very big issue worldwide because every person wants very fast computing and secure electronic data communication via the web. The authentication of electronic data is done by hashing algorithms. Presently researchers are using one-time padding to convert variable-length input messages into a block of fixed length and also using constant initial values that are constant for any input message. So this reason we are proposing the autonomous initial value proposed secure hash algorithm-256 (AIVPSHA256) and we are enhancing the performance of the hash function by designing and compuiting its experimental results in python 3.9.5 programming language.

articleTitle: Dumb-bell shaped Defected Ground Structures MIMO Antenna for UWB Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This work describes a quad-port Ultra Wide Band (UWB) multiple input-multiple output (MIMO) antenna with axial ratio bandwidth that is small and circularly polarised. The planned MIMO system comprises of four identical tulip-shaped radiating components, which are each made up of a slotted partial ground plane with a dumb-bell form and is fed by a 50Ω microstrip line. The elements are aligned orthogonally to achieve high isolation which is 42.61dB. The proposed MIMO covers 3.34-10.70GHz UWB range which gives 7.35 GHz bandwidth. The antenna was designed on a FR4 substrate with a loss tangent of 0.02 and a dimension of 70.7 × 70.7 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Gain 3.40dBi, Envelope Correlation Coefficient (ECC) 0.00025, and return loss 44.67dB are recorded for this MIMO antenna system's diversity performance. Which can be used in all UWB high-speed wireless applications, as well as future smartphones, microwave imaging, and satellite communication.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Software Defect Prediction using Generative Models
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: It is widely known that one of the most helpful phases in SDLC is Software Defect Prediction (SDP). SDP can tell which modules have the highest chances to have bugs and companies can then devote suitable time in analysing those modules. SDP can be extremely helpful but it can be very difficult to predict buggy modules. Recently many studies have shown how in cases where enough data is not present, defect data from different projects can be used; this is called cross-project defect prediction (CPDP). However most of these studies require Homogeneous data for prediction i.e. our source dataset and target dataset must have the same parameters. Many times, especially for newer startups, previous data is not present for defect prediction, in such a case we want to be able to predict defects with data from other projects. We have trained and compared the performance of three models namely a GAN, Variational Autoencoder, and Adversarial Autoencoder for quickly transferring lessons learned about defect prediction among different datasets.

articleTitle: A Compact, Two-Port MIMO Antenna for mm-wave 5G Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a compact, two-port Multiple-input Multiple-output (MIMO) antenna which resonates at 28 GHz for millimeter-wave (mm-wave) fifth-generation (5G) application. While maintaining an appropriate gain of 6.82 dB, the antenna has a larger operational bandwidth of 1.48 GHz and operates in the frequency range from 27.25 GHz to 28.73 GHz. For MIMO application, the proposed antenna system has a two-element Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) arrangement. The dimension of the designed MIMO system is 22 mm x 12 mm x 0.8 mm. To achieve high isolation, the proposed MIMO configuration’s radiating elements are positioned perpendicular to each other. The isolation between two radiating elements is also significantly higher than 30 dB. The proposed MIMO antenna system also features high diversity gain, low channel capacity loss, and good envelope correlation coefficient.

articleTitle: BER Performance using BPSK Modulation over Rayleigh and Rician Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In modern mobile communication, it is important to provide finer as well as productive facility to all the mobile users through improved communication system. In this paper, binary phase shift key (BPSK) modulation is utilized by almost all base stations for their operation to send/receive voice/data over long distance. BPSK modulation technique is one of the efficient modulations in terms of power which requires minimum power during their operation. In this paper, the performance of mobile communication system has been compared over Rayleigh and Rician fading channel in terms of bit error rate (BER). During the transmission of information first Rayleigh fading channel has been considered and then after Rician fading channel to see the effects. The simulation of analytical expression has been performed to determine the BER over these two channels and obtained results has been shown between the BER and transmitted power of the signal. These results show BER response against transmitted power over Rician channel is better as compared with Rayleigh fading channel. Analytical results are verified by using MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Improvement In Voltage Profile of Synchronous Generator Using PID Controller And Artificial Neural Network In Automatic Voltage Regulator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Voltage instability is a major problem that arises due to switching of heavy load, due to which transient conditions occur in the system. Transient conditions may lead to instability of the system. The voltage instability also involves in limitation of the power supply, as a matter of concern the voltage stability is the potential of a power system to preserve the voltage in allowable limits at all the buses in the system subjected under standard conditions and after being subjected to a disturbance, but when these disturbances occurs in a progressive manner then there is some decline in the voltage so the power system seems to have entered in a state of voltage instability. This condition can be removed by introducing an AVR (automatic voltage regulator). In this paper AVR (automatic voltage regulator) is controlled with a PID(proportional integral derivative) controller. ANN (artificial neural network) is used to tune proportional integral derivative controller and to achieve steady voltage waveform which is evidenced by the simulation results and is effective in the system.

articleTitle: A Query driven Backbone based Routing for Mobile Sink based Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Mobile sink improves data delivery performances in resource constraint wireless sensor networks (WSNs), especially in large scale networks. In query-driven data transmission mode, data transmission is provoked only when sensor nodes get query from the sink node. In this way, sensor nodes’ energy conserved. However, in query-driven scenario, data transmission becomes difficult task because sink’s query insertion point and data accumulation point may differ. Thus, to deal with this situation, we proposed query driven backbone based routing protocol (QBR), that construct a virtual backbone structure. Few of the backbone nodes construct a tree structure and these tree nodes save mobile sink location, transmit query to area of interest (AoI) and data to sink. Furthermore, to balance the load of tree nodes, a tree maintenance mechanism is incorporated. Simulation results show that QBR improves the energy consumption and data delivery performances.

articleTitle: Development of a Hybrid Model using Deep Neural Network and XGBOOST for Mortality Prediction of ICU Patients
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: With the rapid development of various machine learning techniques, this paper proposes a hybrid model using Deep Neural Network (DNN) and XGBoost (XGB) to predict the ICU patient's mortality accurately. For prediction of mortality Physionet challenge 2012 dataset is used, which consists of 8000 records (set A and B) and 42 features. The outcome of this study reveals whether the ICU patient will survive or dies. Since, the dataset has large number of missing values and also highly imbalanced, makes the classification problem more complex. To circumvent these problems, k-Nearest Neighbor (k-NN) imputation is used to handle the missing value and (Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique) SMOTE for balancing the dataset. Then, the proposed model is trained using 5-fold cross-validation in 80% of the data. The model is tested with rest 20% of the data and various performance measures such as accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, f1-score, score1 and AUC are obtained. The hybrid model (DNN+XGB) is compared with the Gaussian Support Vector Machine and Multinomial Naive Bayes models and reported to be better predictor with AUC of 75.05%.

articleTitle: Analyzing the best Location for the Central Node Placement for Energy Efficient and reliable WBAN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This paper investigates the best position for the center node for the on-body Wireless Body Area Network (WBAN) using the CM3A channel model operating at the WISM band (2.4 GHz) band. A comparative performance evaluation of signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), bit energy and bit error rate (BER) has been carried out for two considered scenarios with a center node at the right hip and chest. Further Symbol Error Rate (SER) based performance analysis of center node is evaluated and compared for multi-level Frequency Shift Keying (M-FSK) and multi-level Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (M-QAM). Simulation results for the assumed system model exhibits better performance of M-FSK for all cases with the best performance being received for the center node situated at the right hip compared to the chest.

articleTitle: Age Prediction Model using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Age bunch grouping is a perplexing assignment that is utilized to order facial picture into foreordained age classifications. It is a significant undertaking because of its various applications like wellbeing, security, confirmation framework, enlistment, and furthermore in wise social robots. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has as of late shown brilliant execution in examining human face pictures. Programmed age arrangement has become pertinent to a rising measure of utilizations, especially since the ascent of social stages and online media. By and by, execution of existing techniques on genuine pictures is still altogether missing, particularly when contrasted with the huge jumps in execution as of late detailed for the connected errand of face acknowledgment. In this paper we show that by learning portrayals using profound convolutional neural network (CNN), a critical expansion in execution can be gotten on these assignments. To this end, we propose a straightforward convolutional net design that can be utilized in an event of predicting age, when how much learning information is restricted. We assess our technique on the new IMDB-WIKI dataset for age assessment and show it to drastically beat present status of-the-craftsmanship strategies.

articleTitle: Spectral Efficiency Evaluation of Network Coded Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Nowadays, the information technology field is full of wireless approaches due to the spectral efficiency; likewise, in Cognitive Radio Network (CRN), spectral sensing method brings a wide interest. Besides, it has been affected by some serious problems like spectrum allocation, spectrum sharing, packet forwarding, etc. Multi-Input Multi-Output Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) is introduced to provide the network more flexibility. However, the key issues are spectral efficiency and Bit-error-rate (BER). Hence, the aim of this paper is to indicate the CRN performance using novel approaches. Here a novel, Decision Wolf-based Optimized Spectrum Sharing (DWbSS) is developed and implemented in OFDM channel to improve the spectrum efficiency. MATLAB platform has been used to implement work. Primary User (PU), Best Effort User (BEU) and Secondary User (SU) have been identified by the wolf fitness parameter. Subsequently, the performance of presented method is validated in terms of spectral efficiency and BER.

articleTitle: Color Adaptive Robust DWT-SVD Watermarking Algorithm and Limitations : Color Space Comparisons
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Color image watermarking is a technique for digital data authentication and security. Because of the substantial differences in colour aspects, watermarking a colour image is a time-consuming and challenging problem. Noval algorithm DWT-SVD oriented colour image watermarking based on entropy, adapting colour components is proposed to designed in this paper. The algorithim is expected to improve invisibility, of the colour component with the least amount of information is chosen for watermark insertion. For watermark embedding, the is proposed algorithm takes advantage of dual-level security by employing the SVD of logo and wavelet coefficients. The performance of the proposed technique was also examined for three distinct colour spaces: RGB, YCbCr, and LAB. The comparison of watermarking and logo extraction is used to assess qualitative performance. Peak Signal-to-Noise ratio (PSNR) and Normalize cross Correlation (NC) is used in the parametric analysis under the exposure of the various attacks.

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation of Lossless Hyperspectral Compression USING CCSDS 123.0.B-1
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Remote sensing satellites with hyperspectral and multispectral payloads would require large data storage onboard and downlink bandwidth because the data volume collected in a spatial area has multiple spectral band data. With remote sensing satellites collecting hyper-spectral images, compression algorithms are required for efficient utilization of downlink bandwidth. Since increasing the storage or bandwidth is expensive onboard, data compression techniques are utilized for effective utilization of resources. With the knowledge of elemental absorption and reflectance characteristics, spectroscopy aids in identification and analysis of the target. Multispectral or hyperspectral imaging sensors capture the target spatial area in multiple bands. The resolution of bands is much larger (of the order of few 100nm) in multispectral bands. Band gap between adjacent bands in hyper spectral imaging is in 10nm range. Thus formed spectral cube has length and breadth defining the spatial coordinates while the depth of it defines the number of bands. Consultative Committee for Space Data Systems (CCSDS) recommends certain algorithms for lossless and lossy compression which is selected based on the application. This paper details about implementation of lossless compression algorithm defined in CCSDS 123.0-B-1 using predictor and block adaptive entropy coder. The implementation is done on space grade FPGA RTG4150 with an operation frequency of 89.694 MHz with varying pixel depth from 12 to 16bits. This gives a throughput more than 1Gbps.

articleTitle: Resource Aware Energy Efficiency Optimization by Using 6G Technology Based Advanced Virtual Multi-Purpose Embedding Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Now a days, Network Technology is the one of the most important technology, which is used to resolve the shortcomings including network ossification of the current design of the internet. Because of adopted digital business growth Internet becomes success and it increased the competition for bandwidth in the communication. Ultra-high-definition videos and vehicle systems require more bandwidth rates and increase the network connection capacity respectively. The rapid advancement of network visualization and 6G technologies is driven by high bandwidth and high speed parallel communication. This often introduces a new link allocation problems to existing substrate networks in a network visualization environment. In order to solve this far reaching network effects, this paper proposes a new model called Advanced Virtual Multi-Purpose Network Embedding Algorithm (AVMPNEA). In this AVMPNEA model uses clustering method. Clustering is a learning algorithm. The clustering is a process which integrally evaluates the topological node structure, the latency and the related bandwidth between the nodes. The nodes the longevity which are used for selected mapping. Here, the result shows that the proposed AVMPNEA model is better in comparison with other models. In which throughput is high, latency is low and reduction of energy consumption. Hence, this model improves the throughput and the long-term application support.

articleTitle: High Gain (1x4) Compact Arrow Shaped Patch Antenna Array Using Quarter Wave Transformer for 5G mm Wave Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: This research proposes a (1×4) compact patch antenna array that will operate in the 5G millimeter wave range between 44 to 50 GHz, proposed antenna array operates at 6 GHz, which is a quite large frequency range (impedance bandwidth). The patch has hybrid geometry two rectangular patches and two triangular patches were used and placed on FR4 epoxy substrate with a relative dielectric constant of 4.30 and can be used in a variety of applications. The suggested antenna has a total size of 30 mm x 14 mm and a height of 0.8 mm. High Frequency Structure Simulator (HFSS) was used to simulate the return loss & S11, (VSWR), impedance discrepancy and antenna gain of the suggested antenna.

articleTitle: Buck and Boost DC-DC Converters for industrial application with different load
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: In this paper Boost converter has been design using impedance matching network, high mobility transistor and active capacitor. The impedance matching network is used in form of high and low pass filter. This converter is a good boosting factor with resistive and inductive load compare to past decade work. The π and T matching filters are used to enhance the boosting rate. This circuit is applicable in industry application for boosting purpose. The designing of the circuits are low cost. LT-Spice simulation is used to design and simulate the Boost dc to dc converter. Studied boosting characteristics with different load.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Techniques for Disease Prediction in Crops
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 11th International Conference on Communication Systems and Network Technologies (CSNT)
abstract: Agriculture can be considered as backbone of India. It is not only a matter of food, but agricultural crop production has an impact on the entire economy of the country, as all enterprises rely on agricultural results, whether directly or indirectly. Crop pests and diseases are the leading causes of crop loss in India. In order to control disease and pests in agriculture, early disease identification is critical.
